items.title: CME Group Stock And Other Exchange Operators Leveraged To AI Trading
items.summary: The Anthropic IPO has rewritten the script for mega-cap AI, pulling even more market power into a tight cluster of giant platforms and the indices built around them. That concentration can magnify gains when enthusiasm runs hot, and it can also sharpen the pain if expectations reset. This article walks through three stocks exposed to that AI-driven trading surge and explores why some investors are watching them so closely right now. items.title: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Adds Digital Asset Custody Deal And Data Center Risk Tool
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE: ICE) partnered with Abra, with ICE Digital Trust providing custody for assets used in Abra's crypto-backed lending. The custody structure separates institutional collateral from Abra's lending activities to reduce rehypothecation risk for borrowers. ICE introduced a Data Center Site Analytics Tool to assess risk and feasibility for large data center projects before capital is committed.
